
---
title: "DLBCL Gene Expression Analysis: Variability and Power Estimation"
author: "Gauri Agrawal"
date: "2025-12-25"
output: html_document
---

```{r full-analysis, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

## 1. Load Expression Data and Class Labels

eisen <- read.table(
file = "Data/03_eisen.txt",
header = TRUE, row.names = 1, na.strings = "NA", blank.lines.skip = FALSE
)

eisenClasses <- read.table(
file = "Data/03_eisenClasses.txt",
header = TRUE
)

## 2. Align Samples and Classes

samples <- eisenClasses$sample
classes <- eisenClasses$class

# Match and reorder

match_idx <- match(samples, colnames(eisen))
ordered_classes <- classes[match_idx]
class_order <- order(ordered_classes)
eisen_reordered <- eisen[, match_idx[class_order]]

## 3. Gene-Level Expression Comparison

# Select gene 100 for illustration

gene_expr <- as.numeric(eisen[100, ])
gene_classes <- eisenClasses$class[match(colnames(eisen), eisenClasses$sample)]

# Remove NA

valid <- !is.na(gene_expr)
gene_values <- gene_expr[valid]
gene_classes <- gene_classes[valid]

## 4. Boxplot of Gene Expression

boxplot(gene_values ~ gene_classes,
col = c("red", "blue"),
xlab = "Biological Class",
ylab = "Gene Expression",
main = "Gene Expression Differences Between Classes")

## 5. Histograms for Each Class

par(mfrow = c(2, 1))
hist(gene_values[gene_classes == 1], col = "red", main = "Expression - Class 1",
xlab = "Gene Expression", breaks = 10)
hist(gene_values[gene_classes == 2], col = "blue", main = "Expression - Class 2",
xlab = "Gene Expression", breaks = 10)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

## 6. Power and Sample Size Estimation

x <- gene_values[gene_classes == 1]
y <- gene_values[gene_classes == 2]

nx <- length(x)
ny <- length(y)

# Pooled standard deviation

pool_sd <- sqrt(((nx - 1) * sd(x)^2 + (ny - 1) * sd(y)^2) / (nx + ny - 2))

# Effect sizes for 1.5-fold and 3-fold changes

effect_1.5 <- log2(1.5) / pool_sd
effect_3 <- log2(3) / pool_sd

# Calculate sample size for power = 0.8, alpha = 0.01

power_1.5fold <- power.t.test(d = effect_1.5, sig.level = 0.01, power = 0.8, type = "two.sample")
power_3fold <- power.t.test(d = effect_3, sig.level = 0.01, power = 0.8, type = "two.sample")

power_1.5fold
power_3fold

## 7. Transcriptome-Wide Variability

# Standard deviation of all genes

gene_sd <- apply(eisen, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

# Histogram of variability

hist(gene_sd, breaks = 20, col = "red", border = "blue",
xlab = "Standard Deviation", main = "Distribution of Gene Expression Variability")

# Overlay density

dens <- density(gene_sd)
hist_info <- hist(gene_sd, breaks = 20, plot = FALSE)
lines(dens$x, dens$y * max(hist_info$counts) / max(dens$y), col = "black", lwd = 2)

## 8. Sample Size Across All Genes

# Using ssize package if installed (or skip if not)

if ("ssize" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) {
library(ssize)

delta <- log2(3)
power <- 0.8
sig.level <- 0.05

all.size <- ssize(sd = gene_sd, delta = delta, sig.level = sig.level, power = power)

# Plot proportion of genes vs sample size

ssize.plot(all.size, lwd = 2, col = "blue", xlim = c(1, 20), xlab = "", ylab = "")
title(xlab = "Sample size (per group)", ylab = "Proportion of Genes")
title("Proportion of Genes vs Sample Size")
}

```
